risk_note: RV2 by path (orders; rows go back through the attribution and status pipeline). General order rescan per D10-543 and 02 §7.1: a separate stream with query_kind=rescan, its own job rescan-window on the order-sync queue and its own handler, leaving the frozen increment path untouched. Per-platform switch and days come from configuration, defaulting to jd on, pdd off (FU-PDD-RESCAN-QUOTA), 30 and 90 days; taobao is out. One window per stream per tick, a day's round paced evenly, floor 60 seconds; the same offline quota, breaker, queryable-account and site-auth gates as the increment. A round starts at now minus days plus one hour, because adapters refuse windows older than 90 days at run time, and ends no later than the increment cursor. Unchanged rows short-circuit on content_hash and a backward status is rejected by the existing P10 path, so no double entry. Rows first inserted by a rescan raise order_sync_rescan_found_missing, including on a failed attempt. Nothing runs in production yet: rescanConfig is injected by B1-04zr, and only scheduled platforms are rescanned.
